capabilities: add line numbers to code blocks
highlight specific lines in code blocks
configure features per code block with params
extras: README warns that changing only a code block's params may not re-render it in preview mode due to Obsidian's caching.
problem: Obsidian's code blocks have no built-in way to show line numbers or highlight specific lines.
summary: Code block enhancer that adds optional line numbers and line highlighting to fenced code blocks via per-block params.
